technique_name: Describe how virtual reality can be used for educational purpose.
description: Virtual reality (VR) can be a great tool for educational purposes. With virtual reality, students can experience interactive, immersive learning opportunities that help to develop knowledge and skills in different areas. For instance, construction students can use virtual reality to practice electronics engineering or building skills without the need of physical tools. Additionally, VR can be used to take students on virtual field trips, giving them the chance to explore ancient cities or travel
